author: claude
summary: HIG design-review fixes for /voices and /voices/:id: (1) VoiceCatalogCard's 'Build voice' CTA now shows a disabled, spinning 'Building…' state while buildingProfiles has the profile, guards handleCta against re-triggering while in flight, and emits a 'Queued build for {name}' toast (@/utils/toast) on success -- required a new distinct VoicePhase 'building' (voicePhase.ts) so getPrimaryCta can render an in-flight label instead of the idle 'Build voice' label. (2) useVoicesData's 'All' filter-chip count now reads activeVoices.length (grouped voice cards) instead of activeSpeakerProfiles.length (flat variant-profile rows), fixing a count-vs-grid mismatch when any voice has more than one variant. (3) VoiceCatalogCard's name/avatar area is now an explicit clickable/keyboard-focusable affordance to Voice Lab, and the ActionMenu gained an 'Open in Voice Lab' item. (4) VoiceLabPage caps the header attribute-pill row to 6 with VoicePillRow's existing +N expand toggle below a 640px width, moved VoiceIconControls out of the identity header into its own 'Voice Icon' section alongside the other build/edit sections, and fixed the back-link's centered appearance (global button reset's justify-content:center + flex-stretch cross-axis sizing) to leading-edge aligned. (5) SampleManager dropped the redundant 'WAV' pill next to filenames that already show the .wav extension (and the now-dead .sample-manager__format-label CSS rule). (6) VariantEditor now shows the variant's display name on each row so multiple variants are distinguishable. (7) voice-chip-row (engine filter chips) gained a mask-image fade-edge at its existing 768px mobile breakpoint, since no shared fade utility existed in this theme. PhaseStepper's PHASE_INDEX was extended to map the new 'building' phase to the same step index as 'build'.

files.change: VoicePhase gained a 'building' member distinct from 'build'; LABEL_TO_PHASE maps 'BUILDING...' to it; getPrimaryCta returns {label:'Building…', intent:'build'} for it.

CTA button disables + spins on phase==='building'; handleCta guards re-entry and emits a toast via emitToast on successful onBuildNow; card body wrapped in a clickable/keyboard div (data-testid voice-catalog-card-body) calling onNavigateToLab; ActionMenu gained an 'Open in Voice Lab' item.
engineFilterOptions' 'all' chip label now uses activeVoices.length instead of activeSpeakerProfiles.length.
Added isMobile (window.innerWidth<=640) state to cap the header VoicePillRow at max=6 on mobile; moved VoiceIconControls out of the header into a new 'Voice Icon' section in voice-lab-page__sections.
PHASE_INDEX now maps 'building' to the same index as 'build' (required by the VoicePhase union change).
Removed the redundant 'WAV' format-label span next to each sample filename.
Added a variant-name label (getVariantDisplayName) to each variant row's header.

Removed dead .sample-manager__format-label; added .variant-editor__variant-label; fixed .voice-lab-page__back centering (justify-content/align-self flex-start); added mask-image fade-edge to .voice-chip-row's mobile breakpoint.
